Designed with LISA, this limited-edition DualSense® wireless controller brings her unmistakable style into play. 

Featuring signature stars and personal touches inspired by the artist herself, this is a celebration of a global icon whose creativity continues to inspire. 

Available for pre-order on October 2 in highly limited quantities through direct.playstation.com and at participating retailers.
